prompt.text: The capital of France is the largest city in the country and a major European center

interpretations: The pre-registration is the rev-5 comment on issue #29; this script implements it as written.

Activation divisor: the repo has no weight-derived activation divisor (tensor-formats 3.3), so 'the repo's rule for the arm's weight configuration' is read as weight_divisor(amax(T_X(X)), target_arm): the arm's target (6 for C1/X1, 4 for C2/G1/G2/G3) applied to the arm's own transformed activation batch.
The A4 quantizer is applied to bf16(T_X(X)), matching the BF16 activation-storage boundary the reference forward uses (bf16(x[rows]) at reference.py:313).

G1: A is derived by the paper's Adam optimization (App. B; 80 steps, lr 0.12, joint W4A4 loss, d_lr = diag(Sigma_X)), then rounded to BF16 as the paper's explicit-runtime-smoothing case, and W A^-1 is quantized by C2's MSE rule at the arm divisor (pre-reg G1 definition).

G2: the continuous gamma_W is optimized by the paper's weight-only Adam loss with A = I, then the fine E4M3 selection (Eq 45, window [gamma/1.2, gamma/0.3]) is realized over the repo's stored E4M3 words, whose effective step is word/divisor; no canonicalization is applied because A = I removes the rescaling gauge.

G3: the paper's Algorithm 1 (Sec. 4.3) on the whole matrix, not the released code's per-16-column-block scope.  Initialization is the paper's (Sec. 5.3): beta_0,j = sum_i |W_ij|, alpha^-1_0,i = max_j |W_ij beta_j| / 6.  Both inverse scales are projected after every update onto the positive finite E4M3 set with a floor at its smallest positive value 2^-9 (the paper's admissible set includes E4M3 subnormals).  The released implementation instead clamps the projection at the smallest E4M3 *normal* 2^-6, inverts the beta initialization, and splits the matrix per 16-column block; those divergences are recorded, not silently reconciled.  Sensitivity: an earlier run using the released reciprocal beta init and the 2^-6 clamp made alpha^-1 uniform (0.015625) and is preserved as the committed bcd-reciprocal sensitivity report; only G3/X1 differ (pre-correction G3 won 11/25 with median -0.0011, still below the bar).

Secondary metric: the represented weight is the arm's effective weight on the untransformed X (W_eff = W_q * A for G1, W_q * Diag(beta)^-1 for G3/X1, W_q otherwise), compared per 16-element K group against the FP64 oracle.  On the S2 layer-0 matrices this reproduces the pre-registration's stated C2 values (gate 1.9e-2/3.8e-2, up 2.5e-2/5.2e-2, down 1.9e-2/3.8e-2).

S1/S2 arm weight divisors use the FP64 source amax (BF16 values widened, or the exact NVFP4 decode), matching pre-registration table 1, which prints the amax at full precision because the divisor is computed from it.

Activation provenance fallback: the reported run uses the forward capture; the --synthetic path is a fixed-seed (seed 0) standard-normal batch rescaled per gating layer to the S2 input_scale's associated activation absmax 448*6/g, recorded but not exercised.
